papers.title: Halley: A Predictive Control Plane for Optical AI Data Center Networks
papers.desc: A frontier AI model is trained in an AI data center, on tens of thousands of accelerators joined by a dedicated network, and every training step ends with all of them exchanging data at once.

papers.title: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens
papers.desc: LLM-based agentic systems are increasingly combined with CoT reasoning to solve tasks that require accurate reasoning, external knowledge, and multi-step deliberation.

papers.title: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
papers.desc: Generative AI is billed per token, yet tokens are not equally expensive.

papers.title: NitroFusion2: Bringing Adversarial Loss to the Text Stream of Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
papers.desc: Adversarial diffusion distillation has conventionally relied on image features for discrimination.

papers.title: Hybrid Computer Use: A Unified Programmatic, Semantic, and Visual Interface for General Agents
papers.desc: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle tasks ranging from everyday desktop activities to long-horizon professional workflows.

papers.title: GaussianRenderFormer: Transformer-based Rendering of 3D Gaussian Splats
papers.desc: Can a neural network learn to render 3D Gaussian splats on its own, with no rasterizer in the renderer? We present GaussianRenderFormer, a transformer that takes a set of Gaussians and a camera and outputs the image directly.

papers.title: Why Pay for Long Reasoning When Rewrite Do Trick? Causal Effects of Reasoning History Compaction on Future Generation and Agent Cost
papers.desc: Reasoning substantially improves language models' ability to solve difficult problems, but long reasoning traces make these gains expensive.

papers.title: LiveFoley: Dynamic Real-Time Video-to-Audio Generation for Immersive Interactive Worlds
papers.desc: Streaming video-to-audio (V2A) generation is essential for immersive interactive applications.

papers.title: UniRestorer++: Scalable Universal Image Restoration with Multi-Granularity Degradation Modeling
papers.desc: Universal image restoration aims to handle diverse degradations within a single model, but a reliable scaling strategy remains underexplored.

papers.title: Multi-layer Indexer: Overlapping Selection and Attention in DeepSeek Sparse Attention
papers.desc: Sparse attention cuts the cost of long-context inference by making the attention matrix sparse: each query attends only a subset of the sequence, chosen by a fixed pattern or, in recent production LLMs, learned per query.

papers.title: TaoMate-HD: Progressive-Resolution Autoregressive Audio-Video Generation
papers.desc: Streaming digital humans produce detailed video while continuing speech as new text arrives.

papers.title: HERIT: Enabling Global Access to Hanja-to-English Historical Translation by Mitigating Temporal Bias
papers.desc: Historical archives are invaluable for multidisciplinary research but remain inaccessible globally due to severe language barriers.

papers.title: Monitor Accuracy Isn't the Answer: A Decision-Value Framework for Evaluating AI Agent Restart Monitors
papers.desc: Classification accuracy and true-positive and false-positive rates alone do not determine whether restarting an AI agent improves success.

papers.title: Ask, Don't Equip: Question-Driven Coding Agents for Deep Kernel Optimization
papers.desc: LLM agents for GPU kernel optimization sit at two ends of a structure-freedom tradeoff.

papers.title: DRAP: Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity for Continual Learning in Physical AI
papers.desc: Continual learning in physical AI differs from conventional continual learning because small per-step policy errors can accumulate over a trajectory.
